conditions.label: Blinded
conditions.description: Cannot see. Vision-dependent checks auto-fail.

effects.ttrpg: −20 on PER-based checks, auto-fail sight-dependent rolls. Attacks against you have +10.
effects.video_game: −20% accuracy, enemy attacks +10% crit chance against you.

conditions.label: Charmed
conditions.description: Cannot attack the charmer. The charmer has leverage over you.

effects.ttrpg: Cannot attack the charmer. The charmer has +20 on social checks against you. Damage from the charmer breaks the effect.
effects.video_game: Cannot target the charmer. Taking damage from the charmer removes the condition.

conditions.label: Deafened
conditions.description: Cannot hear. Audio-dependent checks auto-fail.

effects.ttrpg: −10 on initiative. Auto-fail PER checks reliant on hearing.
effects.video_game: −10% detect range. No audio cues from the environment.

conditions.label: Frightened
conditions.description: Terrified of the source. Cannot approach it and suffer penalties while it is in sight.

effects.ttrpg: −10 on attack rolls and skill checks while the source is in line of sight. Cannot move closer to the source.
effects.video_game: −10% damage dealt. Forced to retreat if source closes within melee range. Breaks on line-of-sight loss.

conditions.label: Grappled
conditions.description: Held in place by an opponent. Movement and agility are heavily restricted.

effects.ttrpg: Speed becomes 0. −10 on all attack rolls and AGI-based skills. Escapable via contested athletics check.
effects.video_game: Immobilized. −10% attack rating. Mash or use escape skill to break free.

conditions.label: Incapacitated
conditions.description: Cannot take actions of any kind.

effects.ttrpg: Cannot take actions, bonus actions, or reactions. No concentration possible.
effects.video_game: Cannot act, use abilities, or move. Duration varies by source.

conditions.label: Invisible
conditions.description: Cannot be seen normally. Greatly advantaged in combat and stealth.

effects.ttrpg: Cannot be seen. Attacks against you have −20. You have +10 on attack rolls. Advantage on stealth.
effects.video_game: Fully stealthed. Cannot be targeted directly. Attacking or taking damage breaks invisibility.

conditions.label: Paralyzed
conditions.description: Frozen in place. Unable to move or act.

effects.ttrpg: Incapacitated + cannot move. STR and AGI checks auto-fail. Melee attacks from within 1 unit auto-crit.
effects.video_game: Fully immobilized and defenseless. Melee attacks against you are guaranteed hits. Duration in seconds.

conditions.label: Petrified
conditions.description: Turned to stone. Incapacitated and nearly invulnerable.

effects.ttrpg: Incapacitated. DR 20 vs all damage. Immune to poison and disease. Cannot be targeted by beneficial effects.
effects.video_game: Incapacitated. Damage reduction +90%. Cannot be healed or buffed. Requires greater magic to reverse.

conditions.label: Poisoned
conditions.description: Under the effect of a poison. The poison's sub_effects carry the actual symptoms.

effects.ttrpg: The poison applies its sub_effects (damage, drain, control) as symptoms. Resistance (via resist effect with parameter 'poison') may reduce magnitude or duration. The poisoned condition itself is the delivery envelope.
effects.video_game: The poison effect delivers its sub_effects automatically (DoT, debuffs, control). The poisoned condition tracks the overall state; the sub_effects handle the mechanics.

conditions.label: Prone
conditions.description: Knocked to the ground. Vulnerable in melee but harder to hit at range.

effects.ttrpg: −20 on melee attack rolls. Ranged attacks against you have +10. Spend half your movement to stand up.
effects.video_game: Knockdown state. −20% melee damage. Ranged attacks against you have +15% accuracy. Spend 1s to stand.

conditions.label: Restrained
conditions.description: Tied, bound, or entangled. Movement is impossible and attacks are hampered.

effects.ttrpg: Speed 0. −20 on attack rolls and AGI-based skills. Attacks against you have +10. Escape via STR check or teleport.
effects.video_game: Immobilized. −20% attack rating. Incoming attacks have +15% damage. Break via STR check or escape skill.

conditions.label: Stunned
conditions.description: Reeling from a powerful blow or effect. Cannot act and is vulnerable.

effects.ttrpg: Incapacitated + cannot move. −20 on all checks. Attacks against you have +10.
effects.video_game: Staggered for 1–3 seconds. Cannot act. Incoming damage increased by +25%.

conditions.label: Unconscious
conditions.description: Knocked out or asleep. Completely unaware and helpless.

effects.ttrpg: Incapacitated + prone. Cannot maintain concentration. Auto-fail STR and AGI checks. Melee attacks from within 1 unit auto-crit. Restored by healing or time.
effects.video_game: Knocked out (0 HP). Cannot act. Revived when healed above 0 HP or after a timer.

conditions.label: Exhaustion
conditions.description: Accumulated fatigue or debilitating sickness. Stacks in severity.

effects.ttrpg: Stacking condition (6 levels). Level 1: −10 on skill checks. Level 3: −20, speed halved. Level 5: speed 0. Level 6: death. One level removed per full rest.
effects.video_game: Stacking debuff (6 levels). Level 1: −10% skill effectiveness. Level 3: −20%, speed −50%. Level 5: immobile. Level 6: death. Cured by rest or cure effect.

conditions.label: Burning
conditions.description: On fire. Takes fire damage over time until extinguished.

effects.ttrpg: Takes 1d4 fire damage per round at start of turn. Can use an action to extinguish (AGI check DC 10 or drop-and-roll). Water or cure effect ends it immediately.
effects.video_game: Fire DoT tick every 2 seconds. Duration refreshed on reapplication. Extinguished by water, rolling, or cure effect.

conditions.label: Bleeding
conditions.description: A wound that bleeds, dealing health damage over time.

effects.ttrpg: Takes 1 HP damage per round at start of turn. DC 10 Medicine check or bandage (use object) stops the bleed. Some attacks cause severe bleeding (2 HP/round).
effects.video_game: Health DoT tick every 2 seconds. Severity stacks (1–3). Stopped by bandage, healing spell, or out-of-combat rest.

conditions.label: Slowed
conditions.description: Movement speed and action economy are impaired.

effects.ttrpg: Speed halved (rounded down). −10 on AGI-based skills. Cannot take the Dash action. One fewer bonus action per turn if using AP pool: +1 AP cost on all actions.
effects.video_game: Movement speed −30%. Attack speed −20%. Dodge chance −10%. Duration in seconds.

conditions.label: Silenced
conditions.description: Cannot speak or make verbal sounds. Spells with verbal components cannot be cast.

effects.ttrpg: Cannot cast spells that require verbal components (GM determines which schools or specific spells require speech). −20 on social checks that rely on speaking.
effects.video_game: Spellcasting disabled for skills that use verbal components. Subtle/innate casting (if perk-gated) still works. Duration in seconds.

conditions.label: Diseased
conditions.description: Afflicted by a disease effect. Symptoms vary by source.

effects.ttrpg: The disease effect (blight, fever, plague) applies its symptoms. Resistance via END reduces severity. Cured via cure effect with parameter 'disease' or specific antidote.
effects.video_game: Disease debuff with periodic stat drains and health damage. Persistent until cured. May worsen over time if untreated.

conditions.label: Cursed
conditions.description: Under a hex. All attributes or specific ones are reduced.

effects.ttrpg: −2 to all attributes (or specific ones per source). Removed by remove curse spell, cure effect with parameter 'curse', or special ritual. Cannot be removed by rest.
effects.video_game: −X to all relevant stats. Displayed as a red debuff icon. Requires specialized cure item or quest reward to remove.

conditions.label: Exposed
conditions.description: Defenses are compromised. Takes extra damage from all sources.

effects.ttrpg: −10 on evasion and block checks. Armor DR halved. Incoming damage multiplied by ×1.25.
effects.video_game: Evasion −15%. Damage resistance −20%. Incoming damage +X%. Duration in seconds.

conditions.label: Taunted
conditions.description: Forced to focus on the taunter. Attacks against other targets are penalized.

effects.ttrpg: −20 on attack rolls against anyone other than the taunter. Cannot willingly move away from the taunter. Effects break if the taunter attacks an ally or moves out of line of sight.
effects.video_game: Forced aggro on the taunter. −20% damage against non-taunter targets. Taunt immunity after 3 applications (diminishing returns).

conditions.label: Staggered
conditions.description: Knocked off-balance. Cannot react and suffers a penalty to the next action.

effects.ttrpg: Loses next reaction. −10 on the next action taken. Removed at end of next turn or when taking damage.
effects.video_game: Stagger animation plays. Cannot block or dodge for 1–2 seconds. Recovery roll animation plays on exit.
